content.title: About
content.content: The yogurt tube is a single‑serve fermented milk product packed in a convenient plastic tube. It has a creamy texture, mild tanginess, and is often flavored with fruit or berry extracts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The tube design lets you eat a portion without utensils.
Thanks to airtight packaging, pasteurised yogurt stays fresh up to 30 days without refrigeration.
Yogurt tubes became popular in Russia in the early 2000s as a quick snack for kids and athletes.
Some brands enrich the product with probiotic strains for added gut health benefits.
They are a common item in school lunches because they fit easily into backpacks.

items.title: Rich in calcium
items.content: Yogurt provides calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Source of probiotics
items.content: Live cultures such as Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium support intestinal microbiota.

items.title: Low‑fat options
items.content: Reduced‑fat yogurt delivers protein without excess calories.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Yogurt supplies vitamin B12 and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: Lactose is partially broken down by the fermentation process, making it easier to digest.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People allergic to casein or whey may react to yogurt.

items.title: Added sugar in flavored versions
items.content: Fruit‑flavored tubes often contain extra sugar, which can be problematic for diabetics.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the tube refrigerated and consume within 2–3 days.

items.title: Probiotics and immunocompromised individuals
items.content: Those with weakened immune systems should choose yogurt without live cultures.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The yogurt tube is eaten straight from the package. It can be added to smoothies, used as a topping for fruit, oatmeal or granola, or as a filling for pancakes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened tubes in a cool, dry place. After opening, keep the tube refrigerated at 2 °C–6 °C and consume within a few days.
